dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, thin, high-contrast light-colored rings with serrated perimeters located on the dorsal-lateral mid-section. Prominent structures exhibit sharp pixel transitions from dark exterior to a thin light perimeter with dark internal centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily located along the ventral-lateral margin and cervical region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle across the dorsal-lateral plane, with smaller punctate blobs aligned linearly below the primary annuli centroids.
